label: Standards
heading: The commitments we make to every investor.
lede: Institutional habits from day one, written down so you can hold us to them.

items.title: We invest alongside you
items.body: The sponsor invests its own capital in every offering, so our results move with yours.

items.title: Simple terms
items.body: A preferred return, a clear split and no layers of hurdles you need a spreadsheet to follow.

items.title: Fees in plain view
items.body: Every fee, including affiliate fees, is disclosed up front and benchmarked against the market.

items.title: Quarterly letters
items.body: Performance, occupancy and business-plan progress, good news and bad, within about a month of quarter end.

items.title: K-1s by March 15
items.body: Books closed monthly so tax documents arrive on time for your filing.

items.title: Your data, secured
items.body: Subscriptions, documents and distributions handled through a secure investor portal, never by email.
